prompt_for_image_ai:
Create ONE flat vector landing sticker.

SIZE LOCK — IDENTICAL ON EVERY RIASEC LETTER (R, I, A, S, E, C):
- Canvas: exactly 1024px wide × 1024px tall. Fill entire canvas with solid paper #FDFCF8. No transparency. No black background.
- Sticker frame: exactly 780px OUTER WIDTH × 640px OUTER HEIGHT. Not wider. Not narrower. Not taller. Not shorter.
- Aspect ratio of the frame is fixed at 780:640. Letter E must use this exact same height and width as letters R, S, and C — only the border COLOR differs (coral).
- Corner radius ~48px. Border stroke ~10px coral #FF8A65.
- Frame centered: left margin 122px, right margin 122px, top margin 192px, bottom margin 192px.
- Interior fill #FDFCF8.

HEIGHT LOCK: the frame outer height is 640px. Character head sits near the top inner border (~24px padding). Character waist and props are flush to and cropped by the INNER bottom border. Character fills the full interior height — no floating, no short figure with empty paper above and below.

LARGE LETTER LOCK (match gold R, S, C): left half, bold rounded SANS-SERIF block capital E. Fill #FF8A65. Thin white inner offset stroke. Thick dark outer outline #2D2D2D. Letter height about 420px, vertically centered — same letter height and recipe as R/S/C. NOT serif, NOT a different blockier style, no heavy 3D bevel.

CORNER BADGE: ~56px circle bottom-right inside frame, small capital E, coral fill, same sans style.

CHARACTER: young Visionary, light olive skin, short black hair, thin 2px outline #2D2D2D, flat fills, minimal black dot eyes. Faces inward-left toward E. White collared shirt, coral blazer #FF8A65. Right hand: coral megaphone near mouth. Left hand: slim folder with simple upward-arrow accent. Waist flush to bottom border.

Style: KursoKo questionnaire unDraw flat vector. Minimal props. No coins, no crowd.
